newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU Commission opens probe into Alitalia aid.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission opens probe into Alitalia aid.

text.p: The European Commission opened a state aid probe into payments made to Italian airline Alitalia, an EU source said on Wednesday.

The decision, which passed without discussion at Wednesday's weekly Commission meeting, begins a process of investigation likely to last several months into a proposed 1.5 trillion lira capital increase for the struggling carrier.
Wednesday's decision brings Alitalia into a long line of Commission-investigated aid cases which includes state-owned Greece's Olympic Airways, Ireland's Aer Lingus, and TAP Air Portugal.
"The Italians will argue that in their opinion it's not a state aid at all," said one senior Commission official, indicating that this might be why the airline had not been looked at earlier.
"They may have received aid before but there's no way the Commission could have known unless it had been alerted by a competitor or by other means," the official said.
